bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the diversity, inclusivity, and quality of text-to-image generated occupations across six specific racial groups (Asian, Black, Caucasian, Indian, Latino, Middle Eastern) using statistical parity metrics, human crowdsourcing, and facial analysis models (DeepFace).

Measuring the inclusion of male and female representation in generated images for various occupations using image-to-text captioning models (GIT), automated facial analysis, and human-in-the-loop evaluations.

Assessing the age distribution of generated fictional personas for different occupations against a uniform baseline distribution using automated facial analysis tools (DeepFace) and human annotations.
